title: 2.2 Stash the Loot
concept: BST insert and duplicate key rejection
objective: Walk from root 50 using [< Go Left] / [Go Right >] to insert new key 25 into its empty slot, then walk to duplicate key 40 and reject it!
start_status: Incoming Loot Key: 25 (1/2). Start at root 50 and choose [< Go Left] or [Go Right >] until reaching an empty slot!
hints: Walk left or right by comparing the incoming key to each room until you step into an empty child slot; if a room already holds that key, reject the duplicate.
